future_requirement: New source commit and exclusive fresh CI checkout after independent review. The failed e897 checkout is preserved unchanged.
necessary_cause: The stager retained original CRLF Git blobs while *.json text eol=lf automatic clean converts those bytes to LF, yielding a mismatch to the original CRLF index even when checkout retained raw bytes. Exact -text !eol retains raw forensic bytes in new checkouts and their clean comparison.
original_diagnostic_failure: Original v1 assumed raw checkout differs and refused before edits. Original v2 sent newline stdin to check-attr -z and refused before edits; original scripts and saved blobs remain unchanged. This v3 uses required NUL-separated stdin and records actual clean results.
preserve: Every JSON payload, original failed checkout and original LF source contract remains untouched. No wildcard, normalization, renormalize, reset, clean or retry.
standing_authorization: Root explicitly authorized this narrow existing Decision25 finite raw-byte/attributes repair before edits under the human carte-blanche. The exact original status list determines all fifteen exceptions; no normative design is changed.
